annotations.title: Create a transparent video from a plan

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Spends credits. Consumes a plan from plan_transparent_video and starts the render. No subscription is required to CREATE it (only credits) -- but downloading/exporting the finished file later depends on the account's existing entitlement; plan_transparent_video's `downloadWarning` field tells you up front if the account can't download yet. Calling this again with the same planId after it already succeeded is safe -- it returns the same render rather than creating a second one. Returns immediately -- call get_render_status to check progress. Timing varies by model, duration, queue, processing route, and provider demand.
name: create_transparent_video
title: Create a transparent video from a plan
